title: Deploy a Child Contract Deterministically
description: A game factory contract deploys one puzzle-instance contract per season. Off-chain services must be able to predict each instance's address from the factory address and a season salt before the deployment transaction lands.

content.prompt: Which deployer call deploys a child contract at an address derived from the current contract's address and a season salt?

hint: The deployer is scoped before deployment. `with_current_contract(salt)` makes the current contract the deployer and uses the salt for address derivation, so `deploy(wasm_hash)` produces a predictable child address. Without that scope, deployment is not tied to the factory address; `update_current_contract_wasm` upgrades the running contract instead of creating a child.
author: StellarHunts Core

testCases.title: Salt scoped to the current contract
with_address is not a deployer scope
Unscoped deploy has no deterministic parent
Upgrades do not create child contracts
